example: She framed her diploma and hung it above the desk.

example: Their disagreement on the plan ended with a compromise.

example: His dissent on the policy was recorded in the meeting notes.

example: The distinction between the two species was clear under the lens.

example: The establishment of the clinic took the village a full year.

example: The course on ethics asks students to weigh every choice.

example: The expense of the trip was shared by the whole team.

example: The report criticised the exploitation of child labour.

example: The extrovert at the table kept the whole group laughing.

example: Slow fact-checking caught the error before the article ran.

example: The flight to the south was delayed by the evening storm.

example: Food poisoning kept half the class home for two days.
